name: India

demographics.notes: World's most populous country with a massive demographic dividend; over 65% of the population is under age 35, driving a long-term consumer market expansion and STEM workforce growth.

economy.notes: World's 5th largest economy by nominal GDP and 3rd largest by Purchasing Power Parity (PPP); world's fastest-growing major economy, driven by digital public infrastructure (UPI), IT software services, pharmaceutical manufacturing, and the 'Make in India' industrial policy.
major_exports: Refined petroleum products (diesel and gasoline processed from imported crude)
Information technology software and business process management services
Pharmaceutical formulations, vaccines, and generic drugs ('Pharmacy of the World')
Precious gems, diamonds, and manufactured jewellery
Automotive vehicles, tractors, and precision engineering goods
Agricultural products (basmati rice, marine products, spices)
major_imports: Crude petroleum and liquefied natural gas (LNG)
Gold, precious stones, and uncut diamonds
Electronic components, integrated circuits, and smartphones
Coking coal and thermal coal for steel and power generation

military.defence_spending_pct_gdp_source: World Bank WDI (MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS), 2024 data, extracted from user-provided dataset (file last updated 2026-02-24)
military.arms_exports_source: World Bank WDI (MS.MIL.XPRT.KD), constant USD, from user-provided dataset
key_equipment_or_doctrines: Two-Front Deterrence Doctrine: Designed to simultaneously deter or counter synchronized conventional military action by China across the LAC and Pakistan across the LoC
Naval Carrier Battle Groups: INS Vikrant (indigenous 45,000-ton carrier) and INS Vikramaditya operating MiG-29K fighters
Frontline Combat Aviation: Dassault Rafale 4.5-gen omnirole fighters, Su-30MKI air superiority fighters, and indigenous HAL Tejas Light Combat Aircraft
Long-Range Precision Strike: BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles (Mach 3, land/sea/air-launched, joint venture with Russia)
Integrated Air Defense: Russian S-400 Triumf air defense missile regiments and indigenous Akash surface-to-air missile systems
Andaman & Nicobar Command (ANC): India's only tri-service unified theater command, positioned directly astride the northern approaches to the Strait of Malacca

primary_sources: Coal (55% of power generation - essential baseload power from domestic reserves)
Crude petroleum (28% of total energy - over 85% imported, primarily from Russia, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, and UAE)
Renewable energy (12% - rapidly expanding solar parks and wind energy installations)
Natural gas (6% - domestic offshore fields plus imported LNG)
Nuclear power (2% - domestic pressurized heavy water reactors and Kudankulam VVERs)
energy.note: High exposure to global crude oil price volatility; transformed its crude import basket post-2022 by importing heavily discounted Russian Urals crude, refining it domestically for export.

major_ports: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust (JNPT / Navi Mumbai - premier container port)
Mundra Port (Gujarat - largest private commercial and bulk liquids deepwater port)
Chennai Port & Visakhapatnam Port (Major eastern littoral industrial gateways on the Bay of Bengal)
Cochin Port & International Container Transshipment Terminal (Vallarpadam)
strategic_airports: Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL, New Delhi - busiest aviation hub in South Asia)
Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (BOM, Mumbai)
Kempegowda International Airport (BLR, Bengaluru - technology and aerospace corridor)
infrastructure.energy_grid_resilience: National Power Grid operated as a single synchronous frequency system under POSOCO/Grid-India, enabling seamless inter-regional transfer of renewable energy across northern and southern load centers.
infrastructure.digital_infrastructure: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) handling over 13 billion monthly digital transactions; Aadhaar national biometric digital identity system; Mumbai and Chennai subsea cable landing clusters connecting Europe to Southeast Asia.

top_partners: United States (largest single export destination and key technology partner)
China (largest source of manufactured imports, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and solar components)
United Arab Emirates (crucial energy supplier, trade hub, and Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement partner)
Russia (top crude oil supplier post-2022 under bilateral national currency mechanisms)
Saudi Arabia & Singapore (major energy, infrastructure investment, and logistics partners)
chokepoint_exposure: Strait of Hormuz (over 50% of crude oil and LNG imports transit this Gulf bottleneck)
Strait of Malacca (vital export-import corridor for commerce with East and Southeast Asia; monitored by India's ANC command)
Bab el-Mandeb & Red Sea (maritime route for Indian engineering goods and refined fuels heading to European markets)

core_competencies: World-leading IT enterprise software architecture, cloud migration, and tech consulting (TCS, Infosys, Wipro)
Cost-effective commercial space launch and planetary exploration (ISRO Chandrayaan-3 lunar landing, Gaganyaan)
Mass-scale pharmaceutical synthesis, biosimilars, and active drug formulation manufacturing
Digital public infrastructure (India Stack) spanning identity, payments, and open commerce networks
tech_vulnerabilities: Heavy reliance on imported semiconductor logic chips and fab foundries from Taiwan and South Korea
Dependency on imported military jet engines (GE aerospace F404/F414 engines powering HAL Tejas)
Import reliance on China for 65-70% of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) used in domestic drug manufacturing

land_borders: China (3488 km along the disputed Line of Actual Control)
Pakistan (3320 km along the Line of Control and international border)
strategic_chokepoints_adjacent: Six Degree Channel / Great Channel (between Great Nicobar and Sumatra — mouth of Strait of Malacca)
Ten Degree Channel (between Andaman and Nicobar island chains)
Palk Strait (between India and Sri Lanka)

politics.executive: Prime Minister of India is Head of Government holding executive power, leading the Council of Ministers; President of India is constitutional Head of State.
politics.legislature: Bicameral Parliament (Sansad) comprising the Lok Sabha (House of the People, 543 directly elected members) and Rajya Sabha (Council of States, 245 members representing the states and union territories).
politics.judiciary: Supreme Court of India, possessing extensive constitutional jurisdiction, judicial review authority, and administrative oversight of 25 High Courts.

nuclear.delivery_systems: Operational nuclear triad: Land-based road-mobile solid-fuel ballistic missiles (Agni-I through Agni-V ICBMs, including MIRV capability tested in Mission Divyastra), nuclear-capable aircraft (Dassault Rafale, Mirage 2000), and SSBNs (INS Arihant and INS Arighat carrying K-15 and K-4 SLBMs).
nuclear.notes: Estimated 172 nuclear warheads (SIPRI 2024). Governed under the Nuclear Command Authority (NCA) headed by the Prime Minister. Adheres to a declared No-First-Use (NFU) policy and Credible Minimum Deterrence.

strategic_priorities: Deterring Chinese territorial revisionism along the 3,488 km Line of Actual Control (LAC) and modernizing border infrastructure in Ladakh and Arunachal Pradesh
Maintaining decisive maritime dominance across the Indian Ocean Region (IOR) and safeguarding commercial sea lines of communication
Achieving self-reliance in defense industrial manufacturing ('Atmanirbhar Bharat') to replace imported defense platforms
Expanding strategic multi-alignment through the Quad (US, Japan, Australia, India), BRICS+, and the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO)
Accelerating the India Semiconductor Mission to establish domestic wafer fabrication, packaging, and critical electronics manufacturing
dependencies: Crude oil import vulnerability: Over 85% of crude oil is imported, heavily dependent on Gulf and Russian tanker shipments
High reliance on foreign semiconductor foundries for electronics, automotive, and defense hardware
Critical dependence on Russian-origin defense systems for maintenance, ammunition, and spares (~45% of existing military platforms)
Dependence on China for key industrial inputs including Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and solar photovoltaic components
vulnerabilities: Two-front military security challenge: Simultaneous conventional mobilization risk from China and Pakistan across mountainous borders
High fiscal vulnerability to global energy and fertilizer price shocks impacting foreign exchange reserves
Severe climate stress: Exposure to extreme heatwaves, erratic monsoon precipitation patterns, and glacial melt in the Himalayas
Job creation imperatives: Demands to generate millions of high-productivity manufacturing jobs annually for an expanding youth population
strengths: Unsurpassed geographic dominance of the Indian Ocean: Astride the primary global maritime energy routes between the Middle East and East Asia
Andaman and Nicobar Command (ANC): Forward military bastion providing direct physical surveillance and interdiction leverage over China's Malacca trade chokepoint
Unmatched demographic momentum: Youngest median age (28.7) among major global powers with an immense pool of software and STEM professionals
Diplomatic Multi-Alignment Prerogative: Unique global stature enabling simultaneous productive partnerships with the United States, Russia, France, Israel, and the Global South
